results.member_caveat: CESM2: historical r1i1p1f1 but ssp245 r10i1p1f1 (parent r10 absent locally), so its delta SSS = forced change + internal-variability difference between two members. GFDL-ESM4 and MPI-ESM1-2-LR use r1 in both experiments (continuous join). Basins: WOA23 basinmask_01 surface labels, marginal seas folded in, Southern and Arctic excluded; Global = all valid ocean cells. Models lacking a marginal sea have no counterpart.
